finite_index_divisor_carrier_criterion.full_nef_scope: Only H10/12 is the fixed section of the full NS nef chamber in this simultaneous carrier.  The other four are effective finite-index divisor-subsystem chambers.
proof_steps: Choose any ample class H on the one explicit row-39 K3 and set h=sum_{j=0}^3 (sigma^j)^*H; h is ample and sigma-invariant.
For each full-rank stable M_i, h lies in a unique complete M_i-root chamber, and sigma preserves that chamber because it fixes h.
Conjugate that chamber to the archived complete chamber.  The induced chamber involution has the fixed Smith/q fingerprint computed from sigma|M_i.
The exhaustive chamber-group census has exactly one rank-11 involution class with that fingerprint, forcing H10/12, H10/15, H10/16, H10/38, or H10/45 respectively.
Every h-positive square-minus-two simple root is effective by K3 Riemann--Roch, simultaneously for all five systems.
finite_index_divisor_carrier_criterion.statement: Let g be one actual finite-order automorphism of a projective K3 surface and let M_i be finitely many g-stable, full-rank divisor sublattices of NS.  Average one ample class over <g> to obtain a single invariant ample h.  The complete M_i-root chamber containing h is g-stable.  If the complete chamber-group census uniquely identifies the induced action from its fixed-lattice fingerprint, then all corresponding fixed Coxeter sections occur simultaneously. Riemann--Roch makes the h-positive simple roots effective; extra NS roots may only refine these divisor-subsystem chambers.

theorem: The purely non-symplectic order-four UE8A1x2 K3 action carries five invariant full-rank divisor-subsystem chambers.  Their fixed sections are exactly the finite-volume noncompact H10/12, H10/15, H10/16, H10/38, and H10/45 Coxeter polytopes.
